## Python 3.12 has security support until October 2028
<a name="support-info-by-package-eol_python3.12"></a>
+ Start Date: 2024-11-11
+ End Date: 2028-10-01

 [https://devguide.python.org/versions/](https://devguide.python.org/versions/)

AL2023 provides Python 3.12 that can be installed alongside the System Python (Python 3.9). Amazon will provide security patches and support for this version of Python until the upstream end-of-life of Python 3.12, which is estimated to be in October 2028. If a version of Python is required that is supported until the EOL of Amazon Linux 2023, use Python 3.9 which is the System Python for AL2023.

## Python 3.11 has security support until October 2027
<a name="support-info-by-package-eol_python3.11"></a>
+ Start Date: 2023-03-15
+ End Date: 2027-10-01

 [https://devguide.python.org/versions/](https://devguide.python.org/versions/)

AL2023 provides Python 3.11 that can be installed alongside the System Python (Python 3.9). Amazon will provide security patches and support for this version of Python until the upstream end-of-life of Python 3.11, which is estimated to be in October 2027. If a version of Python is required that is supported until the EOL of Amazon Linux 2023, use Python 3.9 which is the System Python for AL2023.

## Python 3.9 (System Python) has security support until June 2029
<a name="support-info-by-package-eol_python3"></a>
+ Start Date: 2023-03-15
+ End Date: 2029-06-30

 [https://www.python.org/dev/peps/pep-0596/\#lifespan](https://www.python.org/dev/peps/pep-0596/#lifespan)

AL2023 has Python 3.9 as the System Python. Amazon will continue to security patch this version of Python until the end-of-life of AL2023, which is beyond when upstream Python supports this version until.

## Amazon Linux 2023 end-of-life
<a name="support-info-by-package-eol"></a>
+ Start Date: 2023-03-15
+ End Date: 2029-06-30

 [https://aws.amazon.com/amazon-linux-ami/faqs/](https://aws.amazon.com/amazon-linux-ami/faqs/)

This is the support statement for AL2023. The end-of-life of Amazon Linux 2023 is June 2029. From this point, the Amazon Linux 2023 packages will no longer receive any updates from AWS.
